text:
About 2.23% of the property was affected. Hansen/UMD mapped roughly 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss in 2021 within the 3,643.5 ha asset (ASSET-A). The loss was corroborated: a later year was observed, and the JRC 2020 forest reference agrees on 98% of the event area.

Context: most of the affected area (68.1 ha) falls in planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda). None is mapped as native forest, and 13.2 ha lies outside mapped forest. Separately, about 37.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was not counted as an event, so it is not included in the 2.23%.

Limits: this shows tree-cover loss only. It does not establish deforestation or land-use change, since cutting a plantation also registers as loss. It also says nothing about cause, legality, who was responsible, or compliance.
